segments.speech: Welcome to today's lesson. We are going to look at one of the most important ideas in object oriented programming, called polymorphism.
segments.subtitle: Welcome. Today: polymorphism.

board.heading: POLYMORPHISM
board.text: One of the big ideas of object oriented programming

segments.speech: Polymorphism means the same interface can have different behaviours. In simple words, you give the same instruction to different things, and each one responds in its own way.
segments.subtitle: Same interface, different behaviours.

segments.speech: Think about animals. We have a general type called Animal. Dog and Cat are both kinds of Animal, so both of them can make a sound.
segments.subtitle: Dog and Cat are both kinds of Animal.

segments.speech: Look at the dog first. When we tell a dog to make a sound, it barks.
segments.subtitle: A Dog barks.

segments.speech: Now the cat. We gave the cat the very same instruction, but this time it meows. Same instruction, different behaviour. That is polymorphism.
segments.subtitle: A Cat meows. Same instruction, different behaviour.

segments.speech: Let us recap. Polymorphism means one interface with many behaviours. It lets us write simpler code, because we can treat different objects in the same way.
segments.subtitle: Recap: one interface, many behaviours.

board.heading: Remember
items: Each object responds in its own way
